cues: Twelve points, five of them on one line.
Any two points make a line: twelve C two, sixty six.
But the five collinear points were counted as ten lines when they make just one.
Subtract ten, add back one: fifty seven.
Any three points make a triangle unless they are collinear: two hundred and twenty minus ten.
And a twelve sided polygon: sixty six segments, minus twelve sides, leaves fifty four diagonals.
